prompt:
Our DevRel team needs to produce polished visual code cards from our TypeScript snippet library for the v2.3.0 changelog and social media posts. The snippet files are already organized under the `snippets/` directory tree in our project workspace.

Please set up a reusable rendering system for the project — we want consistent styling defaults and a named profile called `social` that future teammates can invoke by name. Then batch-process all the `.ts` files under `snippets/` into rendered image assets stored in a folder called `rendered/`. We need a `manifest.json` file produced alongside the rendered assets so our CI pipeline can track which files were processed.

The config file should live at the root of the project workspace and be named `snipgrapher.config.json`.
